h1: Custom Kraft Coasters for Branded Drinkware
metaDescription: Order custom kraft coasters for your business. Eco-friendly, absorbent, and perfect for branding. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Kraft coasters bring a natural, eco-friendly look to your brand. Made from absorbent stone, they handle condensation without sticking to glasses. Ideal for restaurants, cafes, or corporate gifts, these custom kraft coasters offer a subtle, organic surface for your logo. Choose from round or square shapes, or opt for the duo set. Decorate with screen printing or foil stamping for a clean, professional finish.
heroAltText: Custom kraft coasters with absorbent stone surface and branded logo on a wooden table
